objective: 在纯P1-D1、fixed-draining、固定Mooncake/RDMA传输语义下，用真实SGLang GPU KV发送记录验证拓扑无关P→D 12-bin逻辑消息直方图口径，并建立可由完整请求窗口离线生成的scheduler-faithful Hfull teacher基础闭环
execution_model: one local model copy loaded independently by one single-GPU prefill server and one single-GPU decode server; one router; five frozen request waves repeated three times; deterministic CPU teacher and exact alignment after GPU release

research_scope.predictor_output: topology-independent 12-bin sender-counted logical KV-chunk calls and logical bytes per 1000 requests
research_scope.teacher_input: complete ordered request list for offline label generation only
research_scope.future_predictor_input: low-dimensional history profile, model KV structure, fixed P strategy, fixed D strategy and fixed transfer policy

backend_contract.logical_message_unit: one post-TP/CP-filter CommonKVSender.send KV chunk for one request
backend_contract.logical_bytes_unit: kv_page_count times the sum of per-page K/V bytes across all local layers, plus state bytes if any

measurement_contract.arrival_semantics: fixed-draining wave; the next wave is submitted only after the prior wave fully returns
measurement_contract.required_gpu_layout: two distinct GPUs on one host; topology recorded but not used for a placement claim
measurement_contract.raw_storage: profiler JSONL and full P/D/router logs remain outside Git; Git stores only hashes, counts, exact-alignment tables and aggregate 12-bin histograms

workload_scenarios.name: single_cross_chunk
workload_scenarios.purpose: one-token continuation beyond the chunk boundary

workload_scenarios.name: packed_remainder
workload_scenarios.purpose: FCFS batch remainder splits the last request

workload_scenarios.name: mixed_burst
workload_scenarios.purpose: mixed short/medium/long requests and repeated chunk continuation

claim_boundary: PASS proves the frozen P1-D1 Mooncake logical-byte and chunk-call teacher matches representative SGLang GPU execution exactly
Phase40 is a semantic and teacher foundation, not a trained low-dimensional PD predictor and not a six-model generalization result
The logical histogram is topology independent; Phase40 does not establish a physical Mooncake cost curve
The conclusion applies to the frozen non-MLA Qwen3-8B-class model contract, FCFS fixed-draining policy, disabled caches/overlap and exact source commit
Full request lists remain offline teacher inputs and are not authorized as deployed predictor inputs
stop_and_block_if: the exact workflow commit is not checked out or tracked files are dirty
a local Qwen3ForCausalLM model is unavailable or would require a network download
two distinct CUDA GPUs, Mooncake, RDMA or the SGLang router are unavailable
execution would require TP/PP greater than one, a backend fallback, staging, radix cache, overlap or changed chunk policy
the model formula, source SHA, request count, per-request chunks, aggregate histograms or repeat determinism differ
raw trace, logs, model weights, cache, PID or protected data would enter Git
